title: Why Pruning the Extremities Does Not Pain
description: A teaching about discrete degrees within the body. Members proper bear the Living Soul (pain marks soul-conjunction), while hair, nail-tips, and surface flesh are residue grown from the impurities of food, not bearers of the Living Soul. The body-as-land / members-as-trees analogy classifies growths by their response to cutting: those rooted in the soul restore themselves under influx; the outermost growths regrow indefinitely precisely because they are most distant from the divine.
